items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I had been recommended about J.J.--I tell you who first told me about him... was Clarence Little. He came from Indianapolis, the Ferguson Brothers, a booking outfit.

ctx.x: telling you about, his writing. The way I went into New York City and was working that area for a while and had to augment the band, I had been recommended about J.J.--I tell you who first told me about him, I heard of him but had never met him, was Clarence Little. He came from Indianapolis, the Ferguson Brothers, a booking outfit. I think he used to book Clarence and he was almost a part of them and so J.J.--he told me J.J.'s a good writer or something, and he said if you can find him and so when I finally did…
